product.description: The Velora Resonance 12 is a handcrafted 12‑string acoustic guitar designed for expressive play and rich tonal depth. Its spruce top and mahogany back deliver balanced resonance, while the maple fingerboard offers smooth playability. The instrument features a built‑in adjustable truss rod and a satin‑finished finish that protects against humidity fluctuations. Players appreciate the ergonomic neck profile and the lightweight body, which together reduce fatigue during extended sessions. The Resonance 12 is ready to play straight out of the box, with pre‑installed standard nylon strings and a durable strap loop for touring convenience.
